all-tables-random-lgs-pods: At random LGS tables you win 29.0% of games and 22.8% of series, against a fair share of 25% and about 16%. You are the single most common winner: 1,235 of 4,258 games, about four times any other category's count.
Bracket mix barely matters: 29–30% whether you face zero or three bracket-4 decks.
Elesh Norn (cast in 18% of games, 54% win when cast) and Atraxa (61%) are the cards that close games. Codie is removed 1,423 times, about once every three games.
Decking is still the most common single entry in your loss list (48 games). Bind to Life and Entomb still mill after the 25-card stop, so watch your library in long games.
lifegain: Your worst table-mate: 21.1% of games when a lifegain deck sits down.
Lifegain decks win 311 tables, the most of any category. Oloro, Astarion and Dina knock you out most; Karlov and Liesa also win with infinite combos.
Archon of Cruelty (55% win when cast) is your best card here: it drains through their life gain.
typal: Below fair share: 25.6% of games, and you are knocked out first in 35% of these tables, the highest anywhere.
Shilgengar, Clavileño and Kaalia win in combat before your fatties land.
Atraxa wins 67% of the games where it resolves at these tables.
tokens-go-wide: 25.2% of games, at fair share but below your average.
Caesar, Jetmir, Zurgo and Arabella win with wide combat swings.
Elesh Norn and Massacre Wurm are the answers; Aetherize buys a turn.
artifacts: Your best table-mate: 32.1% of games won when an artifact deck sits down.
Your losses here are mostly decking (15) and Osgir in combat; artifact decks rarely kill you outright.
Codie survives longest here: removed 250 times in 673 games.
